name: gosai
description: GOSAI - General-purpose Operating System for Augmented Interfaces

scripts.dev: concurrently --kill-others --names server,desktop --prefix-colors cyan,magenta 'bun run dev:server' 'bun run dev:desktop'
scripts.build:apps: bun run --filter calibration build && bun run --filter interactive-pool build && bun run --filter second-self build && bun run --filter hello-gosai build
scripts.package:mac: bun run build && bun run build:apps && bun run build:server-bin && bun --filter @gosai/desktop run dist:mac
scripts.package:linux: bun run build && bun run build:apps && bun run build:server-bin && bun --filter @gosai/desktop run dist:linux
scripts.python:lint: cd python && uv run ruff check src
